payload.summary: Fixed all four Codex GitHub review findings on PR #457 with TDD: made complete_task refuse to overwrite a cancelled task, routed every phase-changing ESCALATE persistence path through persist_and_project, audited reconcile_work_projection mutations, and classified non-raising projection-callback failure envelopes in persist_and_project instead of reporting them as ok.
completed_work: Added migration 036_terminal_completion_guard.sql: complete_task now updates only status IN ('claimed', 'running') rows and returns reason='task_not_active' with the current status when refused for that reason; WorkQueueService.complete() logs a warning on that refusal.

Added a DB-less static contract test for migration 036 and two PostgreSQL-backed behavioural tests (TestCompleteTaskTerminalCancellation) proving a late complete_task call after reconcile-cancellation is refused and does not overwrite the cancellation, and that the ordinary active-claim completion path is unaffected.
Added a unit test proving the Python-side complete() surfaces status='cancelled'/reason='task_not_active' and logs a warning.

Routed the exception handler, the phase-raise branch, and the GoalGateRefused handler in autopilot.py's run_loop through persist_and_project(..., mode='submit') so ESCALATE transitions reach the queue-projection seam like every other phase change.
Added three run_loop-level tests proving each of those three branches now calls the projection callback with mode='submit' for the ESCALATE transition.

Added get_audit_service().log_operation(operation='reconcile_work_projection', ...) to WorkQueueService.reconcile_projection, carrying the created task id and cancelled task ids; added a unit test and registered the operation in the audit-completeness mutation-surface inventory.

Reworked persist_and_project to classify a mapping callback response whose status is present and not 'ok' as that status (preserving reason/error) with a logged warning, keeping the prior 'ok' behaviour for non-mapping and statusless-mapping responses; added six unit tests covering failed/skipped/error-key/success/statusless-mapping envelopes plus the warning log.

Ran coordinator pytest (targeted: 86 passed; full non-e2e/non-integration: 2439 passed, 11 skipped), coordinator mypy src/ (77 files, no issues) and ruff check . (clean), skills/tests/autopilot (369 passed, 6 skipped), full skills suite (2973 passed, 13 skipped, one pre-existing unrelated environment failure in refresh-architecture's interpreter-resolution test), and openspec validate --strict (valid).

decisions.title: Make cancellation terminal inside complete_task, not just at the caller
decisions.rationale: complete_task updated WHERE id = p_task_id AND claimed_by = p_agent_id with no status filter, so a worker whose task reconcile_work_projection had already cancelled could still flip the terminal cancelled row back to completed/failed. Restricting the UPDATE to status IN ('claimed', 'running') closes the race at the one place every completion path goes through.

decisions.title: Route every phase-changing persistence path in run_loop through persist_and_project
decisions.rationale: Only the ordinary phase-advanced branch called the projection seam; the exception handler, the phase-raise branch, and the GoalGateRefused handler persisted with plain save_state and never reached the coordinator, so a coordinated run could durably enter ESCALATE while the previous queue generation stayed active.

decisions.title: Audit reconcile_work_projection the same way submit() audits submit_task
decisions.rationale: reconcile_projection cancels active tasks and creates the canonical task for a new generation, a mutation surface as significant as submit_task/complete_task, but returned without any audit record.

decisions.title: Classify non-raising projection-callback envelopes instead of reporting them as ok
decisions.rationale: The coordination-bridge helpers return structured {status: skipped|failed, ...} envelopes instead of raising; persist_and_project previously reported every non-raising response as ok, silently hiding refusals from the run loop and its callers.

next_steps: Commit and hand off; the orchestrator re-runs VALIDATE and, if that passes, VAL_REVIEW before returning to the merge gate.

Watch the tests/integration/postgres/ CI job on the next run — the new PostgreSQL-backed TestCompleteTaskTerminalCancellation tests are skipped in this sandbox (no live PostgreSQL/docker access) and only execute there.
